evidence.text:
List of the FIFA Player of the Year
Home > Sports > List > Football > Resources > Winners > Awards > FIFA > Player of the Year (men) FIFA World Player of the Year (Men) The FIFA World Player of the Year award is given annually to the football player who is voted as the best in the world. Here are all the award winners since 1991. Since 2004 the voting process is based on a shortlist of 35 players produced by FIFA, from which team captains, national team managers and select journalists vote for the winner. Statue of Cristiano Ronaldo in the harbour of his hometown Funchal, Madeira From 2010 until 2015, the FIFA player of the year award was merged with the Ballon d'Or and called the FIFA Ballon d'Or. Compare this list to the player of the year according to World Soccer magazine , and also the female player of the year . Including the FIFA Ballon d'Or (years 2010-2015), Lionel Messi has won the award eight times, with Cristiano Ronaldo having won it five times.
